title: Solve 8 + cot theta = 2 cosec squared theta

source.note: 9709/21/O/N/10 Question 5 [6]. Official QP and official MS.

stem:
This question is 9709/21/O/N/10 Question 5, taken from the official QP.

Solve the equation 8 + cot θ = 2 cosec² θ, giving all solutions in the interval 0° ≤ θ ≤ 360°. [6]

steps.name: M1
steps.text_tex: Use \(\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta=1+\cot^2\theta\) (or an equivalent identity) to obtain a quadratic in \(\cot\theta\) or \(\tan\theta\).
steps.note: Official MS: M1, use a correct trig identity to obtain a quadratic in cot or tan.

steps.name: A1
steps.note: Official MS: A1, solve the quadratic correctly. One route: 8+cot θ=2(1+cot^2 θ), 2cot^2 θ-cot θ-6=0, (2cot θ+3)(cot θ-2)=0.

steps.name: A2
steps.note: Official MS: A1 follow through. Independent: cot θ=2 or cot θ=-3/2, so tan θ=1/2 or tan θ=-2/3.

steps.name: A3
steps.note: Official MS: A1, obtain 26.6° or 146.3°. Independent: arctan(0.5)=26.565…°, arctan(-2/3)+180°=146.310…°.

steps.name: M2
steps.text_tex: A correct method is used to find a second angle from either root.
steps.note: Official MS: M1, carry out a correct method for a second answer from either root.

steps.name: A4
steps.text_tex: The four solutions in the interval are 26.6°, 146.3°, 206.6° and 326.3°, and no others.
steps.note: Official MS: A1, remaining 3 answers from 26.6, 146.3, 206.6, 326.3 and no others in the range. Independent: 26.565+180=206.565…, 146.310+180=326.310… .

contexts.note: Stem taken from the official QP PDF (UCLES 2010), Question 5. Official MS reproduced mark by mark. Paper/self-mark. Questions 2 and 7 of this paper were used in earlier packages.
